nodes.label: Privacy-First Local AI Design
nodes.rationale: All data stored locally; no cloud services, no telemetry, no tracking — the entire AI pipeline (Ollama) runs on-device to keep financial data private.

nodes.label: Local LLM via Ollama Architecture
nodes.rationale: Uses Ollama for local LLM inference (Llama3, Mistral, DeepSeek, CodeLlama) instead of cloud APIs so sensitive financial data never leaves the machine.

nodes.label: OCR Fallback Pattern
nodes.rationale: Falls back to pytesseract OCR when pdfplumber text extraction yields empty results, handling scanned/non-searchable PDFs.

nodes.label: Hybrid Extraction Pattern (Regex + LLM)
nodes.rationale: Tries regex pattern matching first for speed and reliability; falls back to LLM extraction only when fewer than 3 investments are found, minimizing LLM calls.

nodes.label: JWT Token Creation Stub (uses secrets.token_urlsafe instead of real JWT)
nodes.rationale: create_access_token uses secrets.token_urlsafe instead of a proper JWT library; comment says 'In production, use actual JWT library', so JWT signing is not yet implemented
nodes.norm_label: jwt token creation stub (uses secrets.token_urlsafe instead of real jwt)

nodes.label: Multi-Source Market Data Fallback Strategy
nodes.rationale: Primary source is Yahoo Finance (free); falls back to Alpha Vantage (requires API key) then Stooq. Uses two-tier cache: in-memory dict for hot path and file-based JSON cache with 1-hour TTL to reduce API calls.

nodes.label: Privacy-First Fully Local Architecture
nodes.rationale: All data stored locally in SQLite; no external cloud services required; Ollama used for local LLM inference; optional local API keys for market data (user-provided). Design choice prioritizes data privacy over convenience of cloud services.

nodes.label: Layered System Architecture (Presentation, API, DB, AI, External Data)
nodes.rationale: Architecture is split into presentation layer (Next.js, Tauri, Capacitor), API layer (FastAPI), database layer (SQLite), AI/LLM layer (Ollama), and external data layer (Yahoo Finance, Alpha Vantage, Stooq). Each layer is independently deployable.
nodes.norm_label: layered system architecture (presentation, api, db, ai, external data)

nodes.label: Mock Historical Net Worth Data Pattern
nodes.rationale: Static mock data used as placeholder for net worth trend — real historical time-series from the backend is not yet wired up; this pattern allows the chart component to render independently during development.
